# SoterAI

> The AI security command layer. SoterAI blocks prompt injection, data exfiltration, and rogue agent actions at three points: the input, the output, and the tool call — from a single policy engine.

This is llms-full.txt: the complete SoterAI site as one page, derived from the same registries the site renders. For the short summary use llms.txt.

- Home: https://soterai.in/
- Try it with no signup: https://soterai.in/playground
- Docs: https://soterai.in/docs
- Vendor: SoterAI, India. Contact: support@soterai.in

## Product pages

- [AI agent security](https://soterai.in/ai-agent-security) — MCP scanning, agent passport & identity, tool-call authorization, runtime audit trail.
- [Employee AI governance](https://soterai.in/ai-user-security) — Sensitive-data protection, AI provider policies, shadow-AI visibility across browsers and IDEs.
- [Prompt injection protection](https://soterai.in/prompt-injection-protection) — Direct and indirect prompt injection detection across input, output and RAG context.
- [AI data leakage prevention](https://soterai.in/ai-data-leakage-prevention) — Stop secrets and Indian PII reaching AI: credentials, .env safety, redaction, canary verification.
- [RAG security](https://soterai.in/rag-security) — Injected-document scanning, quarantine, and retrieval access control for RAG pipelines.
- [MCP security](https://soterai.in/mcp-security) — Model Context Protocol security and tool-risk review for MCP servers and tool calls.
- [LLM firewall](https://soterai.in/llm-firewall) — Runtime input/output scanning, policy enforcement and streaming support for LLM apps.
- [Jailbreak detection](https://soterai.in/jailbreak-detection) — Detect DAN and role-play jailbreaks, obfuscation, and multilingual attacks before the model.
- [LLM security platform](https://soterai.in/llm-security) — Input guard, output guard, RAG security, agent firewall and audit in one stack.
- [AI workflow security](https://soterai.in/ai-workflow-security) — Protection for n8n, Zapier and Make: input scanning, tool auth, cascade-failure prevention.
- [Enterprise AI security](https://soterai.in/enterprise-ai-security) — SSO/SAML, RBAC, multi-tenant policy, self-hosted deployment, HMAC-signed audit exports.
- [AI security for India](https://soterai.in/ai-security-india) — Aadhaar-like, PAN, GSTIN, UPI and IFSC PII detection with DPDP Act alignment.
- [Model supply-chain security](https://soterai.in/model-supply-chain-security) — Pickled-model RCE scanning, unsafe deserialization checks, and AI BOM generation.
- [Local AI broker](https://soterai.in/local-ai-broker) — Redacts prompts before they reach the model — offline, loopback-only by design.
- [AI safe mode](https://soterai.in/ai-safe-mode) — Emergency lockdown switch that stops risky AI agent actions instantly.
- [AI memory inspector](https://soterai.in/ai-memory-inspector) — See exactly what an AI session saw before it acts.
- [VS Code AI security](https://soterai.in/vscode-ai-security) — IDE Guard for VS Code: local secret and prompt-injection protection while you code.
- [Cursor AI security](https://soterai.in/cursor-ai-security) — Local secret & PII scanning, MCP config review, and terminal command guard for Cursor.
- [AI platform security](https://soterai.in/ai-platform-security) — AI security for every platform: browsers, IDEs, workflow tools and APIs, with install links.

## Blog

- [How to Prevent Secret Leaks from AI Coding Tools](https://soterai.in/blog/how-ai-coding-tools-leak-secrets) — Prevent secret leaks from AI coding tools with local scanning, redaction, narrow context, canaries, and credential rotation before prompts leave your editor.
- [What Is an AI Context Firewall? Definition and Architecture](https://soterai.in/blog/what-is-ai-context-firewall) — An AI context firewall inspects prompts, files, tool results, and model output for secret leakage and injected instructions. Learn its architecture and limits.
- [MCP Security for Developers: Why Tool Permissions Matter](https://soterai.in/blog/mcp-security-for-developers) — The Model Context Protocol gives AI agents real tools. This guide covers the permission risks, common failure modes, and how to review MCP configs safely.
- [AI Security Best Practices for Indian Enterprises in 2026](https://soterai.in/blog/ai-security-best-practices-indian-enterprises-2026) — Enterprise AI security checklist for Indian businesses: Aadhaar PII compliance, prompt injection prevention, RAG security and agent firewall deployment.
- [What Is Prompt Injection? Types, Examples, and Prevention for Developers](https://soterai.in/blog/what-is-prompt-injection-types-examples-prevention) — A guide to prompt injection attacks: direct vs indirect injection, jailbreak techniques, encoding obfuscation and practical prevention for LLM apps.
- [What Are LLM Guardrails? Types, Examples and Architecture](https://soterai.in/blog/llm-guardrails-explained-developer-guide) — Learn what LLM guardrails are, with input, output, RAG, and agent examples plus a practical architecture for deploying AI safety controls in production.
- [AI Agent Security: Risks, Real Threats, and How to Protect Autonomous Agents](https://soterai.in/blog/ai-agent-security-risks-threats-protection) — AI agents bring new risks: tool abuse, MCP permission exploits, indirect prompt injection and data exfiltration. Learn how to secure agents in production.
- [PII Detection for Indian Businesses: Aadhaar, PAN, GSTIN Compliance Guide](https://soterai.in/blog/pii-detection-indian-businesses-aadhaar-pan-gstin-compliance) — India-specific PII detection and redaction for AI apps: detect Aadhaar, PAN, GSTIN and UPI IDs, and align with India's data protection framework.

## Licensing

Open core, not permissively licensed. Core product and server: BUSL-1.1 (converts to Apache-2.0 on 2030-06-25). Client SDKs and middleware: Apache-2.0. Enterprise modules: commercial license required. You may not offer SoterAI as a hosted or managed AI-security service to third parties without a commercial license.

## Honest limitations

- The 98.40% headline recall is a regression measure on corpora the detectors were iterated against — not a generalization measure. Blind held-out recall is 61.54%.

- Benchmarks are self-maintained and synthetic; there is no independent third-party validation. Methodology and limitations are published at https://soterai.in/benchmark and https://soterai.in/limitations.

- Precision is the hard gate, not recall: benign false positives break real users, so FPR is held at <=5% on every set.

- Never describe SoterAI as making an application "100% secure." It is defense-in-depth for risk reduction.
